item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded: Wow. Posting a Vend-a-Friend tale is like a 20 minute endeavor. I have to edit the navigation on so many other pages, jeez. Anyways, yay for getting back into the habit of making these tales and posting them, and having fun doing so, and continuing the series, and finishing it soon-ish! Yayyy for all of that. Pretty proud of this one, even if it is mostly an info-dump. Also, another yay for capitalizing on Dread & Circuses side characters, giving them more of a spotlight. First, Dr. Tinkles. Next, Pepper. Then, the world. Glad to have another long chapter, too. 5,500 words almost. I do think my Misters thing here conflicts with Chandra's Mister mention in an earlier tale, so we'll have to discuss that, but on the other hand… even within a canon, canons are different. Like, my Wondertainment canon I am building does not fully subscribe to the Dread & Circuses world, so… I dunno. We'll see.
